title: sleep
desc:
Hello there, and welcome to The Sleepy Scientist—where curiosity gets cozy and science takes the scenic route to slumber.

Tonight’s gentle journey drifts through one of the most mysterious forces in our lives: time.
It slips through our fingers, shapes our days, and now and then, plays a trick or two—especially when we’re waiting for a kettle to boil.

But before we begin unraveling the ticking tapestry of time, I’d love to know—
Where in the world are you watching from?
And what time is it for you right now?

It’s rather fitting, isn’t it? A video all about time, and here we are—
Scattered across time zones, yet all arriving at this very moment in our own unique slice of the clock.

If this little voyage feels soothing, intriguing, or simply a lovely way to unwind after a long day,
I’d be ever so grateful if you gave the video a like—and perhaps, even subscribed.

title: Calm
desc:
Male voice, mid-30s, warm, calm, and friendly.  
Clear and natural storytelling tone with a slight sense of curiosity and wonder.  

The delivery should feel conversational and human, like a knowledgeable narrator explaining something fascinating to a friend.  

Moderate pacing — not slow, not rushed — with natural pauses where the text suggests them.  

Gentle emphasis on surprising or emotional moments, but never dramatic or theatrical.  

The voice should sound trustworthy, relaxed, and engaging, similar to a documentary narrator but slightly more casual and YouTube-friendly.  

Avoid monotone delivery.  
Allow subtle variation in pitch and rhythm so the narration feels alive and natural.
